events.event: The IHSG closed down 0.92% at 5,146.32 on Friday 20 November, its fifth straight daily decline, ending the week 3.71% lower from 5,344.40.
events.key_numbers: IHSG 5,146.32 (-0.92% d/d) · week -3.71% from 5,344.40 · 265 stocks down vs 102 up · LQ45 535.73 (-0.80%) · energy sector -1.42% · value Rp8.09 trillion
events.why_it_matters: IHSG is back near the 5,000 level that triggered the MSCI scare, hitting retail portfolios and reksa dana.
events.spreading_evidence: CNBC Indonesia market headlines and many outlets reporting the weekly fall

events.event: Foreign investors net sold Indonesian shares for the week to 20 November, including Rp947.02 billion on Friday, even as they bought ASII, BBCA and BRIS.
events.key_numbers: Friday net sell Rp947.02 billion · week net sell Rp1.89 trillion (Kontan; Journalarta says Rp2.6 trillion) · top weekly foreign net buys: ASII Rp237.59 billion, BBCA Rp148.97 billion, BRIS Rp79.61 billion
events.why_it_matters: Foreign selling is what keeps pushing the IHSG and the rupiah down.

events.event: The rupiah closed at Rp18,270 per US dollar on 20 November, reported by Kontan as the weakest level ever, despite BI's rate hike to 6.00% on 18 November.
events.key_numbers: Rp18,270/USD spot (-0.09% from Rp18,254) · JISDOR Rp18,278 (per Topik) · prior close 18 Nov Rp18,232 · dollar index 103.73
events.why_it_matters: A weaker rupiah raises prices of imported goods, fuel and overseas tuition or travel.
events.spreading_evidence: record-low headlines across many outlets (Okezone, Kontan, Topik, Demokratis)

events.event: Bank Indonesia reported the Q3 2026 balance of payments swung to a US$100 million surplus, with the current account deficit narrowing sharply to 0.5% of GDP.
events.key_numbers: BoP surplus US$100 million (Q2 deficit, US$9 million per CNBC Indonesia) · current account deficit US$2 billion = 0.5% of GDP vs US$12.6 billion = 3.4% in Q2 · financial account surplus US$2.1 billion · reserves US$146.3 billion end-Sep (5.4 months of imports) · portfolio investment in deficit as foreign SBN inflows fell
events.why_it_matters: Fundamentals look better than the rupiah suggests, but the same day the rupiah hit a record low.
